headline: A 1997 order removed the head of the Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation from Level V of the federal executive pay schedule.
what_it_does: This executive order took the Executive Director of the Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation off Level V of the Executive Schedule. The Executive Schedule is the set of pay levels for top federal officials. The title does not say what pay level or system the position was moved to, if any.

who_it_affects.group: The Executive Director of the Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation
who_it_affects.how: The position was no longer listed at Level V of the Executive Schedule, which can affect how the job's pay is set.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 30, 1997; the exact effective date is not stated in the title.
